name: What should I prepare before discussing my construction budget with a contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before discussing my construction budget with a contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before discussing your construction budget with a contractor, prepare a clear vision of your project goals, including desired functionalities and aesthetic preferences. Gather any existing plans, architectural drawings, or inspiration images you have. It's also helpful to have a preliminary idea of your financial comfort zone and any non-negotiable elements. Hometelligent Inc. advises clients to consider their must-haves versus nice-to-haves to guide initial budgeting conversations effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before discussing your construction budget, define project goals, gather plans or inspiration, and have a preliminary financial comfort zone in mind. Differentiate must-haves from nice-to-haves.
